plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimization device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 21091).
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer (EXINDA-MIB cpuUsagePercent) as a 0-100 percentage averaged across all CPUs over the past minute. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate optimization, shaping, or inspection overload.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load_1
metrics.description: One-minute CPU load of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer (EXINDA-MIB cpuLoad1). The value is hundredths of load, not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load_5
metrics.description: Five-minute CPU load of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer (EXINDA-MIB cpuLoad5). The value is hundredths of load, not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load_15
metrics.description: Fifteen-minute CPU load of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer (EXINDA-MIB cpuLoad15). The value is hundredths of load, not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical RAM of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer in bytes (EXINDA-MIB totalRam, reported in kbytes and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical RAM of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer in bytes (EXINDA-MIB usedRam, reported in kbytes and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free physical RAM of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer in bytes (EXINDA-MIB freeRam, reported in kbytes and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Physical RAM utilization of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer, computed as used/total*100 (EXINDA-MIB usedRam/totalRam). Sustained high usage can degrade acceleration and shaping performance.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Current CPU temperature of the Exinda / GFI ExOS WAN optimizer (EXINDA-MIB cpuTemperature). Abnormally high values may indicate cooling failure or excessive ambient heat.
